quotes.text: The D210022 patch removed osVersionTooLow from the shared SearchSupport class and Windows implementation, and removed its checks from messenger startup, the integration dialog, and Preferences. The remaining osComponentsNotRunning flag has a different meaning: a supported integration whose required service is stopped. This is a scoped cleanup lesson: when retiring a capability gate, remove its definition and every consumer, then preserve other gates that still represent a real state. No dedicated test was added in this commit; existing browser preferences tests cover the remaining states in the current checkout.
